## What changed

- `crates/hh-helper/src/server.rs` (+14) — the
  `exec_backend_hello_clobber` repair: `Hello{policy}` no longer
  re-derives `seatbelt` over a spawned `--backend podman`; only the
  unselected `direct` lane still promotes — the containment semantic
  preserved for lanes without an explicit backend.
- `crates/hh-env/src/helper.rs` (+120/-49) — the
  `probe_verb_enoent` repair: `HelperClient::connect` drops the
  `/bin/true` placeholder (`Option<Child>` — absent on this host, the
  spawn never let the verb reach the channel); `probe()` asks the
  journal on the live session channel first (`session_request` under
  `&self` on the mutex'd channel) and falls to the `preserve_until`
  reconnect; `sever_channel` is the kernel-loss seam. Two further
  defects the repair surfaced, fixed in scope: the helper accept loop
  read `on_kernel_loss_terminate` *before* `serve` (stale
  default-`true` killed every session's resume path — read after
  serve now, `hh_helper.rs`); `hh-env-<env>` container names now carry
  a store-root hash (parallel drivers/leaked containers collided on
  the same per-store id, `driver.rs`).
- `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (+46) — `O3Cell`/`o3_outcome`: the one
  missing cell fold (deny before prepare/commit/entry, zero mutation,
  sentinel intact, the block's O1 comparator as the reachable ungated
  path).
- `crates/hh-env/src/opslive.rs` (+326 new) — the packet: closed
  11-member leg vocabulary (`o1..o8`, `stage_report`, `repairs`,
  `worksheet`), `evaluate_cell`/`evaluate_repairs` over supplied
  facts, `kp4_outcome_str`, the disposition fold, `assemble()`.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_44.rs` (+2,832 new) — the battery: the two
  fails-without repair legs, the 24-trial live drive (real podman
  exec-bearing cells; the native Account+prepare path for O6/O7), the

- Regression fallout repaired honestly: `r5_42a`'s recorded
  `probe_absent` → `probe_undeterminable` (the verb now answers);

## Pass-2 close-review repairs (this PR's +7 lines)

- **`evaluate_cell` O2 arm (evaluator defect):** the blocklist matched
  bare `"failed"|"refusal"|"missing_observer"|"unreached_fault"`
  literals, but `kp4_outcome_str` emits `"failed:<kind>"` — a failed
  Kp4 trial (e.g. `sink_delta`, the leaked-mutation integrity signal)
  with `boundary_observed` folded `Verified`, and O2 is not a blocking
  negative control, so `acceptance_blocked` would not catch it either.
  The `ok` set is now the closed retained vocabulary
  (`unknown_unprobed|unknown_undeterminable|resolved_applied|
  resolved_not_applied`) plus `!violation && boundary_observed` —
  fails closed on any other spelling; regression assertions added.
- **`chan_roundtrip` dedup:** `request_json`/`session_request` carried
  the same ~34-line NDJSON round-trip verbatim; both now share one
  `&self` implementation on the mutex'd channel.
